shortDescription: Manage HTTP compression profiles on a BIG-IP

options.name: buffer_size
options.description: Maximum number of compressed bytes the system buffers before inserting a Content-Length header (which specifies the compressed size) into the response. When creating a new profile, if this parameter is not specified, the default is provided by the parent profile.

options.name: content_type_include
options.description: Specifies the list of the content types that are allowed.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the HTTP compression profile.

options.name: gzip_level
options.description: Specifies the degree to which the system compresses the content. Higher compression levels cause the compression process to be slower. Valid values are between 1 (least compression and fastest) to 9 (most compression and slowest).

options.name: gzip_memory_level
options.description: Number of kilobytes of memory the system uses for internal compression buffers when compressing a server response.

options.name: gzip_window_size
options.description: Number of kilobytes in the window size the system uses when compressing a server response.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the compression profile.

options.name: parent
options.description: Specifies the profile from which this profile inherits settings. When creating a new profile, if this parameter is not specified, the default is the system-supplied C(httpcompression) profile.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the profile exists. When C(absent), ensures the profile is removed.
